column8: 写满了凝露草和打坐菇的笔记，字迹歪歪扭扭。
column9: Notes on Dew-Condensing Grass and Meditation Mushroom, scrawled in messy handwriting.

column8: 第二页沾了点茶水，但勉强能看清。
column9: Page two has a tea stain, but it's mostly legible.

column8: 最后一页缺了角，应该是被谁啃过。
column9: The last page is missing a corner, looking suspiciously chewed on.

column8: 记录了几种稍微高级一点的灵草，字写得很潦草。
column9: Notes on slightly fancier herbs, written in a hurry.

column8: 提到了「歪掉的灵芝也能用」，附了个哭脸。
column9: Mentions that even crooked lingzhi still works, with a little sad face doodle.

column8: 这一页全是采摘小贴士，看起来很用心。
column9: A page full of harvesting tips. Surprisingly thorough.

column8: 最后一页写着「待续」，但好像没有续了。
column9: Ends with a note saying to be continued. It never was.

column8: 描述了几种稀有灵草，纸张已经发黄。
column9: Describes several rare herbs. The paper has yellowed with age.

column8: 提到雷劫余烬草要小心采摘，差点把作者烧了。
column9: Warns to handle Thunder Ember Grass carefully, since it nearly set the author on fire.

column8: 这一页画了张地图，但画得很抽象。
column9: This page has a map on it. A very abstract one.

column8: 末页留了句话：找到的人记得分我一半。
column9: Ends with a note asking whoever finds these to save half for the author.

column8: 封皮烫了金边，内容却只有一行字。
column9: Gilded cover, but the content is just one line long.

column8: 中卷写得很玄乎，大概意思是信则有。
column9: The middle volume is vague. The gist seems to be that believing is the key.

column8: 下卷被人撕了一半，剩下的字看起来很重要。
column9: Half the final volume is torn off, and the remaining text looks important.

column8: 第一课：先把火关小一点。
column9: Lesson one: turn the flame down a bit.

column8: 第二课：闻到焦味就该停手了。
column9: Lesson two: if it smells burnt, stop immediately.

column8: 第三课：炸了也没事，下次再来。
column9: Lesson three: if it blows up, just try again.

column8: 第一条：千万别站在最高的地方。
column9: Rule one: never stand on the highest point.

column8: 第二条：金属法器收好，别问为什么。
column9: Rule two: put away anything metal, and don't ask why.

column8: 第三条：实在躲不开，就闭眼，反正帮不上忙。
column9: Rule three: if you can't dodge it, close your eyes. It won't help, but you'll feel better.

column8: 第一条心得：挂机也是修炼的一种。
column9: Tip one: idling counts as cultivation too.

column8: 第二条心得：能坐着就别站着。
column9: Tip two: if you can sit, don't stand.

column8: 第三条心得：摸鱼也要讲技巧，别太明显。
column9: Tip three: slacking off needs subtlety. Don't be obvious.

column8: 第四条心得：以上心得，作者自己也没做到。
column9: Tip four: the author never actually followed any of these tips.

column8: 第一章：先从打坐不睡着开始。
column9: Chapter one: start by not falling asleep while meditating.

column8: 第二章：吃药材之前先确认能不能吃。
column9: Chapter two: check if the herb is edible before eating it.

column8: 第三章：成仙之前，先活下去。
column9: Chapter three: before ascending, survive first.

column8: 第一条：遇到奇遇先别慌。
column9: Rule one: don't panic when an encounter pops up.

column8: 第二条：死亡不是结束，是转世的开始。
column9: Rule two: death isn't the end. It's just the start of reincarnation.

column8: 第三条：丹药虽好，别贪多。
column9: Rule three: pills help, but don't overdo it.

column8: 第四条：活得久比活得猛更重要。
column9: Rule four: lasting long matters more than going hard.

column8: 今天打坐三个小时，老板没发现我在修仙。
column9: Meditated for three hours today. The boss didn't notice I was cultivating.

column8: 突破失败了，明天继续上班，假装什么都没发生。
column9: Breakthrough failed. Going to work tomorrow like nothing happened.

column8: 转世了，新的一天，新的搬砖。
column9: Reincarnated. New day, new grind.

column8: 第一条：转世之前的烦恼，转世之后就不记得了。
column9: Tip one: whatever worries you now, you won't remember after reincarnating.

column8: 第二条：上辈子的称号，这辈子还能用。
column9: Tip two: titles from your past life still carry over.

column8: 第三条：死得越搞笑，下辈子运气越好，可能。
column9: Tip three: the funnier the death, the better next life's luck. Maybe.

column8: 第一条：突破前烧香，纯属心理安慰。
column9: Tip one: lighting incense before a breakthrough is pure psychological comfort.

column8: 第二条：穿幸运颜色的衣服，没用但好看。
column9: Tip two: wear your lucky color. Useless, but stylish.

column8: 第三条：失败了就怪丹药，从来不怪自己。
column9: Tip three: blame the pill if it fails. Never blame yourself.
